title: Services
summary: Services that fail to start, hang or stop unexpectedly.

events.title: A service failed to start
events.meaning: Windows could not start a service. The message names the service and the error.
events.causes: A wrong account or password for the service, a missing file, or a broken dependency.
events.next: Open the service settings and check its account, its path and the services it depends on.

events.title: A service could not start because a dependency failed
events.meaning: A service needs another service that did not start.
events.causes: The service it depends on is stopped, disabled or failing.
events.next: Find the dependency named in the message and fix why it does not start.

events.title: A service took too long to start
events.meaning: Windows waited for a service to start and gave up. The message shows how long it waited.
events.causes: A slow or busy PC, a stuck service, or a service that is waiting on something.
events.next: Try starting the service again, and check for slow disks or network at start-up.

events.title: A service did not answer in time
events.meaning: Windows asked a running service for something and it did not reply in time.
events.causes: The service is busy or stuck, or the PC is overloaded.
events.next: Restart the service and check what is slowing the PC.

events.title: A service hung while starting
events.meaning: A service started but then stopped responding before it was ready.
events.causes: A bug in the service, a missing resource or a conflict.
events.next: Restart the service, and update or repair the software that owns it.

events.title: A service stopped with an error
events.meaning: A service ended and reported an error. The message includes the error text.
events.causes: A bug or a missing resource.
events.next: Read the error text in the message, then update or repair the software that owns the service.

events.title: A service stopped with a service-specific error
events.meaning: A service ended with an error code that only the service itself understands.
events.causes: A bug or a problem inside the service's own software.
events.next: Search for the service name and the error code, and check the software's own logs.

events.title: A service crashed and Windows applied a recovery action
events.meaning: A service stopped unexpectedly, and Windows ran the recovery action set for it, such as a restart.
events.causes: A crash in the service or software it depends on.
events.next: Check the Application log at the same time for the crash details.

events.title: A service stopped unexpectedly
events.meaning: A service ended without being asked to. The message names the service.
events.next: Check the Application log at the same time for crash details and update the software.

events.title: A service start type was changed
events.meaning: The start type of a service was changed, for example from manual to automatic.
events.causes: A person, an installer or a tool changed it.
events.next: Check the change was expected if the service is important.

events.title: A new service was installed
events.meaning: A service was added to the system. The message shows its name and file path.
events.causes: A program install or driver install, or possibly unwanted software.
events.next: Check you recognise the service name and the file path.
